## Row {height="auto"}

::: {.card title="Survey Origins, Inferential Design & Analytical Scope"}
The **Public Attitudes to Data and AI (PADAI) Tracker Survey**, commissioned by the UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (**DSIT**) and the Responsible Technology Adoption (**RTA**) Unit and conducted by **Savanta**, monitors longitudinal shifts in how the UK public perceives data governance, institutional trustworthiness, and artificial intelligence across four waves (**Wave 1** $n=4,250$; **Wave 2** $n=4,320$; **Wave 3** $n=4,225$; **Wave 4** $n=4,947$).

Rather than presenting static point estimates, this interactive dashboard surfaces **statistical power, finite-sample volatility, and demographic interaction effects**:

1. **Significance-Mapped Slopegraph:** Evaluates structural shifts between Wave 1 (`col a`) and Wave 4 (`col d`). Line weight and stroke encoding are driven directly by two-tailed column proportion $Z$-tests ($p < .05$).
2. **Dynamic Uncertainty Ribbons:** Computes finite-sample binomial standard errors ($SE = \sqrt{p(1-p)/n}$) natively in the browser, visibly expanding confidence intervals as you drill down from national aggregates ($n \approx 4,947$) to smaller regional or ethnic cohorts ($n < 150$).
3. **Longitudinal Cohort Transitions (Rosling Bubble Scatter):** Animates joint trajectories of **AI Awareness** (`Table 82`) versus **Institutional Trust & Data Utility** (`Table 1` / `Table 22`), weighted by subgroup sample size ($n$).
4. **Cross-Highlighted Distributional Ridge Plots:** Compares full 4-point Likert trust distributions (`Tables 3–12`) across sectors and demographic strata with synchronized cross-panel hover highlighting.
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Load pre-processed tidy dataset produced by scripts/etl_padai_tracker.py
raw_data = FileAttachment("data/padai_dashboard.csv").csv({ typed: true });

// Parse bidirectional significance and normalize waves
dataset = raw_data.map(d => {
  const wave_num = +String(d.Wave).replace("Wave ", "");
  const parts = String(d.Significance_Flag || "").split(":");
  const col_letter = parts[0] || "";
  const beaten_letters = parts[1] || "";
  return {
    ...d,
    wave_num,
    col_letter,
    beaten_letters,
    // Exclude unasked wave placeholders where Value == 0 and no letters exist on Wave 1/2
    is_valid: !(d.Value === 0 && beaten_letters === "" && wave_num < 3 && (
      String(d.Metric_Type).includes("pharmaceutical") ||
      String(d.Metric_Type).includes("Regulators") ||
      String(d.Metric_Type).includes("Banks") ||
      String(d.Metric_Type).includes("HR and recruitment") ||
      String(d.Metric_Type).includes("held accountable")
    ))
  };
}).filter(d => d.is_valid);

// Helper lookup for Z-critical values
z_lookup = { "0.90": 1.6449, "0.95": 1.96, "0.99": 2.5758 };
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "1. Significance-Mapped Slopegraph: Wave 1 vs. Wave 4 Structural Shifts"

slope_data = {
  const sub_rows = dataset.filter(
    d => d.Table_Name === selected_table_focus &&
         d.Demographic_Category === selected_demog_cat &&
         (d.Wave === "Wave 1" || d.Wave === "Wave 4") &&
         !["Total", "Unweighted Total", "Mean"].includes(d.Metric_Type)
  );

  // Group by Subgroup + Metric_Type to evaluate bidirectional significance (col 'a' vs col 'd')
  const grouped = d3.group(sub_rows, d => `${d.Subgroup}|||${d.Metric_Type}`);
  const pairs = [];

  for (const [key, rows] of grouped.entries()) {
    const w1 = rows.find(r => r.Wave === "Wave 1");
    const w4 = rows.find(r => r.Wave === "Wave 4");
    if (!w1 || !w4) continue;

    // p < .05 if Wave 1 beats Wave 4 ('d' in w1.beaten_letters) or Wave 4 beats Wave 1 ('a' in w4.beaten_letters)
    const is_sig = w1.beaten_letters.includes("d") || w4.beaten_letters.includes("a");
    const delta = w4.Value - w1.Value;
    const short_metric = w1.Metric_Type.replace(/\s*\(e\.g\..*?\)/g, "").trim();

    pairs.push(
      {
        Subgroup: w1.Subgroup,
        Metric_Type: short_metric,
        Wave: "Wave 1",
        wave_x: 1,
        Value: w1.Value,
        Unweighted_N: w1.Unweighted_N,
        Sig_Flag: w1.Significance_Flag,
        is_sig,
        delta,
        pair_id: key
      },
      {
        Subgroup: w4.Subgroup,
        Metric_Type: short_metric,
        Wave: "Wave 4",
        wave_x: 4,
        Value: w4.Value,
        Unweighted_N: w4.Unweighted_N,
        Sig_Flag: w4.Significance_Flag,
        is_sig,
        delta,
        pair_id: key
      }
    );
  }
  return pairs.filter(d => d.Subgroup === selected_subgroup);
}

  marks: [
    // Non-significant lines: dashed & semi-transparent
    Plot.line(

      {
        x: "Wave",

        stroke: () => "Non-Significant Drift (p ≥ .05)",

    Plot.line(
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "2. Dynamic Uncertainty Ribbons: Sample Size & Standard Error Sensitivity"

ribbon_data = {
  const z_crit = z_lookup[ci_level];
  return dataset
    .filter(
      d => d.Table_Name === selected_table_focus &&
           d.Demographic_Category === selected_demog_cat &&
           d.Subgroup === selected_subgroup &&
           !["Total", "Unweighted Total", "Mean"].includes(d.Metric_Type)
    )
    .map(d => {
      const p = d.Value;
      const n = d.Unweighted_N;
      // Native Binomial Standard Error: SE = sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)
      const se = n > 0 ? Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n) : 0;
      const ci_low = Math.max(0, p - z_crit * se);
      const ci_high = Math.min(1, p + z_crit * se);
      return {
        ...d,
        short_metric: d.Metric_Type.replace(/\s*\(e\.g\..*?\)/g, "").trim(),
        se,
        ci_low,
        ci_high,
        half_width_pp: z_crit * se * 100
      };
    });
}

mean_sample_n = d3.mean(ribbon_data, d => d.Unweighted_N) || 0
mean_moe_pp = d3.mean(ribbon_data, d => d.half_width_pp) || 0

html`<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #4b5563; margin-bottom: 6px;">
  <strong>Active Cohort:</strong> <code>${selected_demog_cat} → ${selected_subgroup}</code> |
  <strong>Mean Unweighted $n$:</strong> <code>${Math.round(mean_sample_n).toLocaleString()}</code> |
  <strong>Mean ±Margin of Error (${(Number(ci_level)*100).toFixed(0)}% CI):</strong> <code>±${mean_moe_pp.toFixed(2)} pp</code>
</div>`

Plot.plot({
  height: 430,
  marginLeft: 55,
  marginRight: 30,
  marginBottom: 40,
  style: {
    background: "transparent",
    fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif",
    fontSize: "12px"
  },
  x: {
    domain: [1, 2, 3, 4],
    tickFormat: d => `Wave ${d}`,
    label: "Survey Wave"
  },
  y: {
    domain: [0, 1],
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: d3.format(".0%"),
    label: "Point Estimate ± Dynamic CI Ribbon"
  },
  color: {
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    // Dynamic confidence interval ribbon: widens automatically when Subgroup N shrinks
    Plot.areaY(ribbon_data, {
      x: "wave_num",
      y1: "ci_low",
      y2: "ci_high",
      fill: "short_metric",
      fillOpacity: 0.22,
      curve: "monotone-x"
    }),
    Plot.lineY(ribbon_data, {
      x: "wave_num",
      y: "Value",
      stroke: "short_metric",
      strokeWidth: 2.5,
      curve: "monotone-x"
    }),
    Plot.dot(ribbon_data, {
      x: "wave_num",
      y: "Value",
      fill: "short_metric",
      r: 4,
      title: d => `${d.short_metric}\n${d.Wave} (${d.Subgroup})\nEstimate: ${(d.Value * 100).toFixed(1)}%\nUnweighted n: ${d.Unweighted_N}\nSE: ±${(d.se * 100).toFixed(2)} pp\n${(Number(ci_level)*100).toFixed(0)}% CI: [${(d.ci_low * 100).toFixed(1)}%, ${(d.ci_high * 100).toFixed(1)}%]`
    })
  ]
})
```

### Column {width="48%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "3. Longitudinal Cohort Transitions: AI Awareness vs. Institutional Trust (Rosling Scatter)"

// Scrubber / Playback controls for Wave 1 -> Wave 4 interpolation
viewof wave_scrubber = Inputs.range([1, 4], {
  value: 4,
  step: 0.05,
  label: "Playback Wave (1 → 4):"
})

viewof y_trust_target = Inputs.select(
  [
    "The NHS",
    "Academic researchers at universities",
    "The Government",
    "Big technology companies (e.g., Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Apple)",
    "Social media companies (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X)"
  ],
  { value: "The Government", label: "Y-Axis Trust Target (Table 1):" }
)

rosling_trajectories = {
  // X-axis: Table 82 ' NET: Could explain at least partially ' (or 'NET: Heard of ')
  const x_rows = dataset.filter(
    d => d.Table_Name === "Table 82" &&
         d.Metric_Type.trim() === "NET: Could explain at least partially" &&
         d.Demographic_Category !== "Digital engagement"
  );
  // Y-axis: Table 1 selected organisation Net Trust
  const y_rows = dataset.filter(
    d => d.Table_Name === "Table 1" &&
         d.Metric_Type.trim() === y_trust_target &&
         d.Demographic_Category !== "Digital engagement"
  );

  const y_map = new Map(
    y_rows.map(d => [`${d.Demographic_Category}|${d.Subgroup}|${d.wave_num}`, d])
  );

  const joined = [];
  for (const x of x_rows) {
    const key = `${x.Demographic_Category}|${x.Subgroup}|${x.wave_num}`;
    const y = y_map.get(key);
    if (y) {
      joined.push({
        Demographic_Category: x.Demographic_Category,
        Subgroup: x.Subgroup,
        wave_num: x.wave_num,
        ai_awareness: x.Value,
        net_trust: y.Value,
        Unweighted_N: x.Unweighted_N
      });
    }
  }

  // Interpolate smoothly at current wave_scrubber position
  const by_cohort = d3.group(joined, d => `${d.Demographic_Category}|${d.Subgroup}`);
  const current_points = [];
  const trail_segments = [];

  const w_floor = Math.floor(wave_scrubber);
  const w_ceil = Math.min(4, Math.ceil(wave_scrubber));
  const alpha = wave_scrubber - w_floor;

  for (const [cohort_key, pts] of by_cohort.entries()) {
    pts.sort((a, b) => a.wave_num - b.wave_num);
    for (const pt of pts) {
      if (pt.wave_num <= wave_scrubber) {
        trail_segments.push({ ...pt, cohort_key });
      }
    }
    const p0 = pts.find(d => d.wave_num === w_floor);
    const p1 = pts.find(d => d.wave_num === w_ceil) || p0;
    if (p0 && p1) {
      const interp_x = p0.ai_awareness + alpha * (p1.ai_awareness - p0.ai_awareness);
      const interp_y = p0.net_trust + alpha * (p1.net_trust - p0.net_trust);
      const interp_n = Math.round(p0.Unweighted_N + alpha * (p1.Unweighted_N - p0.Unweighted_N));
      current_points.push({
        cohort_key,
        Demographic_Category: p0.Demographic_Category,
        Subgroup: p0.Subgroup,
        ai_awareness: interp_x,
        net_trust: interp_y,
        Unweighted_N: interp_n
      });
      trail_segments.push({
        cohort_key,
        Demographic_Category: p0.Demographic_Category,
        Subgroup: p0.Subgroup,
        wave_num: wave_scrubber,
        ai_awareness: interp_x,
        net_trust: interp_y,
        Unweighted_N: interp_n
      });
    }
  }
  return { current_points, trail_segments };
}

Plot.plot({
  height: 440,
  marginLeft: 55,
  marginRight: 30,
  marginBottom: 45,
  style: {
    background: "transparent",
    fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif",
    fontSize: "12px"
  },
  x: {
    domain: [0.35, 0.90],
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: d3.format(".0%"),
    label: "Net AI Explanation Capability (Table 82: Could Explain AI)"
  },
  y: {
    domain: [0.15, 0.95],
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: d3.format(".0%"),
    label: `Net Trust in ${y_trust_target.slice(0, 28)} (Table 1)`
  },
  r: {
    range: [5, 26]
  },
  color: {
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    // Longitudinal comet trails showing path from Wave 1 to current slider wave
    Plot.line(rosling_trajectories.trail_segments, {
      x: "ai_awareness",
      y: "net_trust",
      z: "cohort_key",
      stroke: "Demographic_Category",
      strokeOpacity: 0.35,
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      curve: "catmull-rom"
    }),
    // Cohort bubbles sized by Unweighted_N
    Plot.dot(rosling_trajectories.current_points, {
      x: "ai_awareness",
      y: "net_trust",
      r: "Unweighted_N",
      fill: "Demographic_Category",
      fillOpacity: 0.78,
      stroke: "#111827",
      strokeWidth: 1.2,
      title: d => `${d.Subgroup} (${d.Demographic_Category})\nWave: ${wave_scrubber.toFixed(2)}\nAI Explanation: ${(d.ai_awareness * 100).toFixed(1)}%\nNet Trust: ${(d.net_trust * 100).toFixed(1)}%\nUnweighted n: ${d.Unweighted_N.toLocaleString()}`
    }),
    Plot.text(rosling_trajectories.current_points, {
      x: "ai_awareness",
      y: "net_trust",
      text: "Subgroup",
      dy: -12,
      fontSize: 10,
      fontWeight: "600",
      fill: "#1f2937"
    })
  ]
})
```

### Column {width="52%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "4. Cross-Highlighted Sector Trust Ridge Plots (Joyplots Across Demographics)"

// Full 4-point Likert scales across sectors (Tables 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 12)
sector_table_map = new Map([
  ["Table 3", "The NHS"],
  ["Table 5", "Academic Researchers"],
  ["Table 12", "Banks & Finance"],
  ["Table 7", "Big Tech Companies"],
  ["Table 4", "The Government"],
  ["Table 6", "Social Media"]
])

likert_points = new Map([
  ["Do not trust at all (1.0)", 1.0],
  ["Do not trust much (2.0)", 2.0],
  ["Somewhat trust (3.0)", 3.0],
  ["Trust a lot (4.0)", 4.0]
])

// Smooth continuous density interpolation across the 4 Likert anchor points for ridgelines
ridge_density_data = {
  const raw_likert = dataset.filter(
    d => sector_table_map.has(d.Table_Name) &&
         d.Wave === "Wave 4" &&
         d.Demographic_Category === selected_demog_cat &&
         likert_points.has(d.Metric_Type)
  );

  const grouped = d3.group(raw_likert, d => `${d.Table_Name}|${d.Subgroup}`);
  const grid_x = d3.range(1.0, 4.05, 0.1);
  const curves = [];

  for (const [key, rows] of grouped.entries()) {
    const [t_name, subgroup] = key.split("|");
    const sector = sector_table_map.get(t_name);
    const weights = rows.map(r => ({
      score: likert_points.get(r.Metric_Type),
      prob: r.Value,
      n: r.Unweighted_N
    }));

    // Gaussian kernel smoothing (bandwidth = 0.42) over discrete Likert mass
    const bw = 0.42;
    for (const x of grid_x) {
      let density = 0;
      for (const w of weights) {
        const u = (x - w.score) / bw;
        density += w.prob * Math.exp(-0.5 * u * u);
      }
      curves.push({
        Sector: sector,
        Subgroup: subgroup,
        likert_x: Number(x.toFixed(2)),
        density,
        Unweighted_N: weights[0]?.n || 0
      });
    }
  }
  return curves;
}

// Reactive hover state for cross-panel ridge synchronization
mutable hovered_ridge_subgroup = null

ridge_chart = {
  const active_sub = hovered_ridge_subgroup || selected_subgroup;

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    height: 485,
    marginLeft: 135,
    marginRight: 25,
    marginTop: 35,
    marginBottom: 40,
    style: {
      background: "transparent",
      fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif",
      fontSize: "11.5px"
    },
    fx: {
      label: null,
      domain: [
        "The NHS",
        "Academic Researchers",
        "Banks & Finance",
        "Big Tech Companies",
        "The Government",
        "Social Media"
      ]
    },
    x: {
      domain: [1, 4],
      ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4],
      tickFormat: d => `${d}`,
      label: "Trust Scale (1 = Not at all → 4 = Trust a lot)"
    },
    y: {
      axis: null,
      domain: [0, 0.95]
    },
    fy: {
      label: null,
      domain: available_subgroups,
      padding: 0.08
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(ridge_density_data, {
        fx: "Sector",
        fy: "Subgroup",
        x: "likert_x",
        y: "density",
        fill: d => d.Subgroup === active_sub ? "#0f62fe" : "#94a3b8",
        fillOpacity: d => d.Subgroup === active_sub ? 0.65 : 0.22,
        curve: "basis"
      }),
      Plot.lineY(ridge_density_data, {
        fx: "Sector",
        fy: "Subgroup",
        x: "likert_x",
        y: "density",
        stroke: d => d.Subgroup === active_sub ? "#0043ce" : "#64748b",
        strokeWidth: d => d.Subgroup === active_sub ? 2.4 : 1.1,
        curve: "basis",
        title: d => `${d.Sector} — ${d.Subgroup}\nScale Score: ${d.likert_x}\nRelative Density: ${d.density.toFixed(2)} (Wave 4, n=${d.Unweighted_N})`
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#cbd5e1", strokeWidth: 0.75 })
    ]
  });

  // Attach cross-panel hover listener to synchronize subgroup highlighting across all 6 sector facets
  d3.select(plot)
    .selectAll("path")
    .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .on("mouseenter", function (event) {
      const title_el = d3.select(this).select("title");
      if (!title_el.empty()) {
        const raw_title = title_el.text();
        const match = raw_title.match(/—\s*(.+?)\n/);
        if (match && match[1]) {
          mutable hovered_ridge_subgroup = match[1].trim();
        }
      }
    });

  return plot;
}
```
